name: Bitcoin
_comment_version_mask: BIP 320 version rolling (overt AsicBoost). Every current SHA-256 ASIC asks for it in mining.configure; without a mask the pool declines and most firmware drops to a slower mode or refuses to mine.
_comment_peerMagic: pchMessageStart from chainparams.cpp: mainnet f9beb4d9, testnet4 1c163f28 (Bitcoin Core 28+; testnet3 was 0b110907, signet 0a03cf40).
_comment_mainnet: Address parameters as hex. bech32 enables bc1q (P2WPKH) and bc1p (P2TR) pool and miner addresses.
